items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1958-08-08; 1958-09-03
items.q: John McCurdy was dead a long time, sir. Yeah. ... He wasn't all that old. No, he played like the devil.

ctx.x: John Rovershire. And he died there in the city then? Oh, he did? You remember?
He was dead a long time. Not John, I mean the Cush. John McCurdy was dead a long time, sir. Yeah.
And when he died, sir. Because he just skipped out of Chicago and never heard from him up there.
